About

Who I Am

Hi! I'm Rafael Jade V. Solis, a Bachelor of Science in Information Technology graduate, majoring in Programming, from Southern Leyte State University. I'm now looking for a full-time opportunity where I can put my web development skills to work and keep growing as a developer.

During my internship at CreativeDevLabs, I developed and maintained web applications using PHP, Laravel, HTML, CSS, and MySQL — shipping features, fixing bugs, and improving performance as part of a team, with a focus on the back end using Laravel and Filament, collaborating through Git.

With my team, I also led our capstone project, an Automated Registration and Dispatch System, from planning through database design and development. I'm detail-oriented, adaptable, and eager to bring that same ownership to a technology-focused team.
